column4: Instructions to access the Discrete Mode Layer in RC (HL02401, HL02402, HL02403)

column6: Set the RC to TV Mode
Press and hold the Source Select key
While holding the Source Select key enter MENU and LAST CH in sequence
If the user is successful the TV LED will blink 3 times and the RC will be locked to TV mode

column4: Instructions to exit the Discrete Mode Layer in RC (HL02401, HL02402, HL02403)

column6: Set the RC to TV Mode
Press and hold the Source Select key
While holding the Source Select key enter 1, 6, 4, 3 in sequence
If the user is successful the TV LED will blink 3 times and all device modes on the RC will be accessable.
